==Description==
'''Winter Express''' is an emote that could have been obtained at Level 39 of the premium [[The Final Act Event#The Final Act Battle Pass|The Final Act Battle Pass]] track. It was made by STEALTH_NOVA. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. The player is unable to interact with it and able to move while performing the emote.

Upon use, the player summons a blue train and drives it. Sound effects can be heard while driving it.

It had a cost of {{PlushieSnowman|1,450}} or {{Robux|173}} ({{Robux|138}} during the Christmas 2025 Sale), with a total cost of {{PlushieSnowman|25,505}} or {{Robux|4,400}} ({{Robux|3,504}} during the Christmas 2025 Sale).

==Trivia==
*'''Winter Express''' is based on the train that appears in the survival intermission lobby during winter.
